finance.title: Financial Group — Risk Management Module Implementation
finance.description:
A large financial group with a sprawling subsidiary structure had no unified view of risks. Each division maintained its own Excel registers, data was not consolidated, and top management made decisions based on outdated information.

We implemented a GRC risk management module with a centralized register, automatic escalation and a C-level dashboard. After launch, the time to collect risk reports dropped from 3 weeks to 2 days, and the number of incidents reaching a critical stage without response decreased by 74%.

isMaturityCase.title: Unified Approach to Information Security Maturity Assessment in a Heterogeneous Group of Organizations
isMaturityCase.subtitle: A comprehensive audit approach was implemented for organizations with different industry-specific IS requirements. Through adaptive checklists and a unified scoring system, comparable maturity assessments and unified group-level analytics were achieved.
isMaturityCase.problemText: The challenge was to conduct a comprehensive audit of a group of organizations with different industry and functional specifics. Differing information security requirements in each company made it difficult to apply a single assessment methodology, while maintaining comparability of results and correctness of ratings between group members.
solutionItems: Customization mechanisms for audit requirements adapted to company and industry specifics were implemented
Automated response generation based on adaptive checklists was realized
A scoring system for quantitative evaluation of audit results was configured
Audit time was reduced through process automation
An IS maturity model for standardized assessment was introduced
Unification of assessment results while preserving industry specifics was ensured
Accuracy and comparability of audit data across divisions was improved
Scalability of the methodology for different types of organizations was ensured
isMaturityCase.resultsLeft: More than ten organizations from various industries were assessed using adapted checklists tailored to their applicable requirements and activity specifics. This ensured audit relevance for each company without losing the systemic approach.
isMaturityCase.resultsRight: All results were consolidated into a unified IS maturity model, ensuring data comparability between organizations. The final information is presented in unified dashboards and analytical reports for convenient comparison and decision-making.
